title: Restricted Claude file tool prevents a mistaken path but v4 refuses the recovered submission
observation: Original GEMM+SiLU Turn 16 wrote to gemm-silu instead of gemm_silu and failed the exact path gate. The fresh restricted wrapper blocks a mistaken outside write in resume qualification; the author subsequently writes the correct candidate and returns a successful exact terminal. The native result retains the denied attempt, and v4 refuses permission_denials before considering the recovery. The controlled probe directly blocks outside Read/Write/Grep/Glob and symlink Read; Edit is blocked by read-before-write, not independently by a witnessed path gate.
proposed_change: Opt-in v5 requires matching native invocation, restricted denial notice and errored completion for every denied attempt; only successful writes witness candidate production. Preserve v3/v4 and all original artifacts, exact final path, no-follow custody and replay checks. Qualify the new wrapper and v5 together before device experiments.
promotion_disposition: Lab transport successor, not a Compiler optimization or a change to scientific read isolation. Original failures remain failures. Software validation, retained-stream interpretation and fresh live two-turn qualification are required before launch.
